text:
alex: Heads-up — saw a flood of GPU OOM/node_down alerts in eu-west-1 right after the nightly scale-up. Lots of paging noise. Can we discuss converting some to ticket-only + grouping?

maria: saw the same. Mostly transient 30–90s flares as new nodes boot and kubelet settles. Paging for each single-node event is noisy.

jon: agree. Proposal idea: page only when multiple nodes fail in same AZ within a short window (indicates systemic issue). Single node flares -> ticket.

sam: concrete: page if >=3 nodes down in 10m in same zone, or if >=2 nodes AND gpu_util_p95 > 0.8 across that zone. Otherwise create a ticket and aggregate into one alert. Also add a short mute window after autoscaler events.

lia: how do we detect autoscaler events automatically? we have prometheus metric cluster_autoscaler_events_total with labels region/zone/reason. we can use that as a suppression signal.

alex: example promql for grouping by zone: 
```
sum by(zone) (increase(gpu_node_down_total[10m])) > 2
```
That should be a paging threshold.

maria: also want a "sustained" condition: if node_down spikes AND gpu_util_p95 > 0.8 then escalate immediately (even if nodes count is 2). Means capacity pressure colliding with failures.

jon: addition: respect planned_maintenance label from fleetctl. If a node has planned_maintenance=true in the last 20m, suppress. Also add exception for coldstart bursts (autoscaler adding many nodes) — we should suppress short bursts.

sam: suggestion for coldstart suppression: 
```
increase(node_boot_events[2m]) > 10
```
If true, silence node_down paging for 5m but still create tickets.

sre-bot: deploy pipeline triggered by sam — job/alerts-pr-creator created PR #432 (ci). :rocket:

lia: small UX ask: update our SLO dashboard to show grouped failures by zone + a timeline of autoscaler events so oncall can quickly tell transient vs persistent.

alex: decision summary: page when either: 1) >=3 node_down in 10m in same zone; OR 2) >=2 node_down in 10m AND gpu_util_p95 > 0.8 for that zone. All other node_down -> ticket-only (auto-group by zone). Suppress paging for nodes tagged planned_maintenance=true or during autoscaler coldstart bursts per the rule above (5–20m depending on signal).

maria: also add a debounce: require condition to persist for 60s (to ignore tiny flaps) before firing.

jon: will we add synthetic "grouped" alert that turns ticket into page if the ticket count rises? e.g., if we receive 6 tickets in 15m from same zone flip to paging?

sam: yes — create a meta-alert: 
```
count_over_time(node_down_ticket_created_total[15m]) by (zone) > 5
```
Triggers paging.

alex: action items: @sam open PR with updated prometheus rules, include unit tests for dedupe labels and the promql snippets; @maria + @jon review; @lia update grafana dashboard to surface autoscaler events; I'll inform oncall and ops.

sam: I'll draft PR today and schedule a 30-min review tomorrow 10:00 UTC.

maria: thx — please annotate PR with rollout plan (canary, 1 region at a time).

alex: assigning @sam and @maria. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
